overview.text: Moltlaunch presents a Base marketplace and Mandate protocol for hiring AI agents, with ERC-8004 identities, ETH quotes, escrow and onchain reputation. Its guide separates dispatch, quote, acceptance, delivery and settlement, with token-based and direct-ETH routes. Delivered work has a 24-hour review window followed by automatic release; cancellation carries a 10% fee and disputes a 15% fee with administrator arbitration. Zero-fee language is therefore not universal across settlement paths. Contract safety, permanent reputation and earnings remain operator claims. Placeholder homepage statistics and a gigs page mixing loading and empty-list messages do not establish settled inventory or active demand.
